history.summary: Bind evidence, QA, media, final page and delivery versions while scaling article depth, FAQ and visuals to the reader task.
changes: Bind QA, page composition and commercial output to exact draft revision, content hash and evidence hash.
Set word, FAQ and visual requirements from content type, reader intent and evidence coverage rather than one universal threshold.
Audit the current final visible Page Payload and derive FAQ structured data only from visible FAQ blocks.
Expose reader-verifiable sources and only use internal links from synchronized WordPress inventory.
Record model provenance and usage without logging prompts, secrets or source bodies.

history.summary: Model heterogeneous sources as evidence containers, audit segmented extraction and independent source families, and drive production with an explicit Opportunity state machine.
changes: Add Source Segments, Evidence Spans, Extraction Coverage and Source Families for exhaustive, non-truncated claim extraction.
Add Topic Clusters and Coverage Matrices with content-type evidence requirements and explainable readiness.
Make approval apply to one exact Opportunity, persist evidence waits and resume one-to-one Candidate creation automatically.
Keep source diagnostics, research drafts, frontend pages and publish packages separate; compose commercial content only after QA.
Add chunked large-video upload, staged progress, auditable Claim exclusion and Knowledge visibility controls.

history.summary: Separate entity identity, semantic relations and Claims, and introduce the isolated Affiliate Provider/Asset/Intent/Tracking phase.
changes: Add entity type, granularity and geographic constraints with auditable merge review and undo.
Separate Claim values, qualifiers and scope, and classify compatible, enrichment and refinement relations before conflicts.
Introduce Provider and Affiliate Asset registries with block intent, fallback, density limits and qualified opportunities.
Render structured commercial blocks safely and record explicit Frontend capability gaps.
Aggregate privacy-minimal impression and click events while preserving Research and Evidence Ledger separation.

history.summary: Admit explicitly authorized source-note images into the publication asset pool and prefer evidence-linked real photos in WordPress drafts.
changes: Record the content owner's confirmation that manually selected source-note images are authorized for SoloToChina publication.
Trace each matched source asset through its source note and WordPress media record.
Use verified maps, infographics or non-factual original illustrations only when no suitable real-world asset exists.
Preserve fact verification, human publishing decisions and the human-selected source boundary.

history.summary: Add strategy history and distinguish research use of source images from publication eligibility.
changes: Expose immutable strategy version history and retain each downstream record's creating version.
Allow saved source images in OCR, multimodal understanding and research evidence.
Publish real-world images only when ownership, official status, license or permission is confirmed.
Keep data-backed maps and infographics deterministic and use generated images only as non-factual illustrations.

history.summary: Establish human-selected intake, evidence-first production, human approval, SEO/GEO review and draft-only WordPress delivery.
changes: Require explicit human capture and prohibit automatic discovery, bulk scraping and access-control bypass.
Separate Claims, destination Knowledge, content opportunities, canonical content, QA and commercial composition.
Require human approval before article planning and always deliver WordPress content as drafts.
